title: Magic Card size caps (ADR 0042)
description: Shape of tools/size-caps.json, the one source of every dist size cap. Read by tools/check-dist-size.mjs. magic-card.js is gated on gzip bytes through a stage ladder; every other file on raw bytes under an Architect ceiling. A raised cap or ceiling needs a ceo_decisions entry written by the Lead after the CEO said yes in chat; agents never write one.

gzip.description: How gzip bytes are measured. zlib.gzipSync(buffer, { level }) on the pinned Node. CI fails when process.versions.zlib differs from `zlib`; a local run with another zlib prints the result as not authoritative.

node.description: Exact Node version, equal to .nvmrc and the CI setup-node version, e.g. 24.11.1

final_cap.description: 60 KiB, CEO Brief Gate 2026-10-20. The checker also holds this number as a constant, so editing the JSON cannot move it.

current_stage.description: The stage whose cap is active. Moved forward only, by the stage-close commit.

cap.description: gzip bytes. null until the stage closes; then the measured gzip of the landing commit (no margin). Each cap <= the previous stage's cap; S2 cap <= final_cap.

measured.description: gzip at landed_commit, kept for the record.

trace_ms.description: Warn-only time to first card, median of 3: { plain, effect }.

files.description: Every other dist .js file by logical name (the content hash stripped: magic-card-<name>.<hash8>.js -> magic-card-<name>.js). A dist file with no entry fails (AC7). An entry with no file fails unless `optional` is true.

raw.description: Cap: measured + 5 %, rounded up to 1 KiB, never above `ceiling`.

ceiling.description: Architect ceiling. A measured size above it means code was copied in: report it. Raising it needs a CEO decision.

note.description: What the old CAPS comment said: what is in it and who set the number.

ceo_decisions.description: Append-only. Written by the Lead only, after the CEO said yes in chat. CI compares tools/size-caps.json with the base branch: every entry cap, stage cap, file ceiling or raw cap above a new file's ceiling that went up must have an entry here with matching field and to.

date.description: Date of the CEO's chat message.

field.description: JSON pointer of the raised value, e.g. /entry/stages/1/cap or /files/magic-card-flows.js/ceiling
